messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Taking sertraline late in pregnancy may raise the risk of newborn problems that need longer hospital stays, breathing support, and tube feeding, and of persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN), a serious lung problem. Use in the month before delivery has been linked with a less than two-fold increase in the risk of postpartum hemorrhage (heavy bleeding after birth).
Stopping treatment is not automatically the safer choice. In one study of 201 pregnant women with a history of major depression, those who stopped their antidepressant during pregnancy were more likely to relapse than those who continued. This is a decision to make with your doctor.
Sertraline oral solution contains 12% alcohol and is not recommended during pregnancy, because there is no known safe level of alcohol exposure in pregnancy.
There is a pregnancy registry that collects information on antidepressant use in pregnancy. You can join by calling 1-866-961-2388.

The relation 'has risk during pregnancy' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with an increased risk of the medical condition or outcome specified by the object entity when used during pregnancy.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'has increased risk in': The subject drug may pose a higher risk of adverse effects in the population or group specified by the object entity.
C. 'has pregnancy registry': The subject drug is associated with a registry that collects information about the health of individuals exposed to the drug during pregnancy and their babies, as specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
